proposals.evidence: DEDR 4797 full article (p. 426) gives 4797 Ma. māṭuka to build, construct; māṭṭam making. Ko. ma·ṭm ( obl. ma·ṭt- ) fashion of doing things, action, wonderful thing; ma·ṛ- (ma·ṛy-) to do, act (< Badaga). To. soty mo·ḍ- to swear Bhat maḍɨ “to do” matches Lindgren Koraga maḍɨ “do” in form and sense; this cross-source match is a candidate lead, with the full DEDR article defining the family. Both source identities and dialect tags are preserved.
